facts.name: Read-heavy product catalog
facts.brief: Millions of reads, few writes. Serve product pages fast and cheap.
checks_passed: A CDN exists for static assets
checks_failed: Hot reads come from a cache
facts.pushback: A merchandiser edits a price. How long until every shopper sees it?

sections.requirements: Serve product pages under 200ms p99 at four nines. Price edits may lag 60s. Checkout is out of scope.
sections.scale: 8M DAU x 60 requests = 480M/day, /86400 = 5.5k/s average, x3 for peak = about 17k/s.
sections.api: GET /products/{id} returns the product plus stock; GET /search?q= returns a page of ids.
sections.dataModel: Product keyed by product_id, partitioned on it because every read is by id.
sections.bottleneck: The database at 17k/s. Cache-aside on Redis, then read replicas.
sections.tradeoff: Chose cache-aside over write-through; rejected it because writes are rare.
